reason: B proposes a more physically established and directly testable thermally activated slip/recovery mechanism for FCC FeNiCrMn without assuming an ill-defined universal density combining dislocations, faults, and twins. A is more novel but extrapolates a critical-defect/phase-transformation model from Co-containing Cantor alloy and extreme deformation, adds an unsupported 20–30% prediction, and relies on post-mortem measurements that cannot decisively identify a threshold at the onset of hardening.
